type: monospace for identifiers and reason codes

state_semantics.ALLOW: green plus check icon plus ALLOW text
state_semantics.BLOCK: red plus stop icon plus BLOCK text
state_semantics.NEEDS_APPROVAL: orange plus review icon plus NEEDS_APPROVAL text
state_semantics.NOT_ASSESSED: gray plus unknown icon plus NOT_ASSESSED text
state_semantics.MONITOR: blue plus explicit NO ACTIONS ARE BLOCKED text
state_semantics.ENFORCE: purple/high-contrast boundary plus ACTIONS MAY BE BLOCKED text

non_copy: no copied navigation labels beyond generic functional terms
